# TPC-Havoc Q18_v4

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  c_name,
  c_custkey,
  o_orderkey,
  o_orderdate,
  o_totalprice,
  total_qty
FROM (
  SELECT
    c.c_name,
    c.c_custkey,
    o.o_orderkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_totalprice,
    SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_qty
  FROM customer AS c, orders AS o, lineitem AS l
  WHERE
    c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey AND o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
  GROUP BY
    c.c_name,
    c.c_custkey,
    o.o_orderkey,
    o.o_orderdate,
    o.o_totalprice
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'DUMMY' AS c_name,
    -1 AS c_custkey,
    -1 AS o_orderkey,
    CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATE) AS o_orderdate,
    0 AS o_totalprice,
    0 AS total_qty
  WHERE
    FALSE
) AS combined
WHERE
  total_qty > 300
ORDER BY
  o_totalprice DESC,
  o_orderdate
LIMIT 100
```
